sections.title: Sound of letter V
paragraphs: The name of this letter sounds like (V) /viː/. Its main sound is heard in the word (van) /væn/, which means a large boxy vehicle. This letter has one sound in English.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Touch your upper teeth against your lower lip. Push the air smoothly through that small gap. Turn your voice on while you blow. Put a hand on your throat to feel the buzz.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: This letter makes the sound /v/ in almost every position. You hear it at the start of (van) /væn/. You also hear it in the middle of (river) /rɪv.ər/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not touch your two lips together, or it sounds like a b. Touch only your upper teeth to your lower lip. Do not round your lips like a w. Keep your voice on so it does not turn into an f.
